promises.target: growth of over 10% this year as compared to the last year
promises.quote: The broad expectation, which our Chairman also conveyed, is growth of over 10% this year as compared to the last year.

reported.quote: The company sold a total of 2,422,713 units in financial year '25-26, compared to 2,234,266 units in the previous year.
The company registered record net sales of over INR1.74 trillion in financial year '25-26, a growth of 20.2% over the previous year.
The company achieved its all-time high net profit of over INR144.4 billion in financial year '25-26 compared to net profit of about INR142.9 billion in the previous year.
The company recorded its highest ever quarterly sales of 676,209 units, up 11.8% from quarter 4 of the previous financial year.
During this period, the company achieved record net sales of about INR 500.79 billion compared to about INR388.39 billion in the same period a year ago.
Operating profit, EBIT for quarter 4 of this year increased by 30.4% over quarter 4 of the previous financial year, reaching an all-time high of over INR44 billion.
Despite the growth in operating profit, net profit declined by 6.9% year-on-year to nearly INR36 billion, primarily due to mark-to-market impact

quarter_margin.name: operating profit margin EBIT
quarter_margin.quote: Sequentially, the operating profit margin EBIT has expanded to 8.8% of net sales compared to 8.1% in quarter 3 of the financial year.
